title: Café Gratitude x Medical Medium Collaboration Coming Soon
text: I'm standing in Cafe Gratitude right now and I'm honored to announce a collaboration between Cafe Gratitude and medical medium medical medium recipes are going to be in Cafe Gratitude so people can find the food they need to heal with and Cafe Gratitude which is incredible the chef here elevated incredible medical medium recipes but elevated them to a level that's mind blowing and you have to taste it yourself seriously it's going to be incredible and you know what's amazing about this because when you go out to restaurants you're like does this have this in it does this have that in it you know what's in here is there this bad vinegar is there white wine vinegar in here is there soy in here is there gluten in here so many people are worried but no more not here Cafe Gratitude okay because they already go by so many different requests for people they look out for people but they took the medical medium recipes that were already clean and pure and for healing and they were like yeah we're taking this to the next level we're going to have it here that's the collaboration so I'm really excited about this no oils in there which is amazing easy on the salt you know what happens is when you eat in a restaurant and you get filled up a lot of things can happen afterwards you can feel like okay now I'm starving again shortly after and then you feel kind of like ripped off because you just ate and now you're hungry again or you feel bogged down and greasy and heavy that's not happening with these recipes and CA gratitude it's a whole different experience I challenge you to try it out and see what you think it's healing recipes for people where you feel satiated your body gets fueled it gets what it needs you can then go out and do what you need to do go out and exercise go out to the beach go live your life go work whatever it is and you feel like your body is being cared for by these incredible recipes that Cafe Gratitude just elevated which is a whole another level of incredible so you guys I'm letting you know this this is it right here so there's going to be an event too coming up so look out for that because pretty soon these recipes are going to be on the menu I'm going to be in here a lot I'm excited I can't wait [Music]
